baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus subject is defined by having received the book, while its predicate is reciprocal scattering after the evidentiary arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book-root supplies joining into a coherent whole, but the separation-root supplies dispersal of a gathered whole. The verse therefore contains an internal reversal: joined textual authority does not guarantee a joined recipient community.

activation_trace.role: Scattering a gathered whole is the literal image and supplies the community's centrifugal outcome.
Joining one thing to another is the literal image and makes the book the internal counterforce to scattering.
Granting something to someone supplies the shared act by which the subject acquired its textual identity.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely reports disagreement among people who possess scripture.
changed_reading.after: It stages a reversal in which recipients joined by a granted textual corpus become the very collective that scatters into parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive temporal construction locates the scattering only after the clear evidence has arrived.
baseline_models.mechanism: The evidence-root carries both disclosure and separation, while the predicate-root carries distinguishing and setting apart. Clarification can therefore expose and harden boundaries rather than automatically erase them.

activation_trace.role: Becoming visible or clear supplies the disclosure that removes informational cover.
Separation after prior connection supplies a second edge to the evidence: disclosure also marks boundaries.
Distinguishing two things turns the group's division into the social realization of a clarified difference.
Afterness supplies the one-way temporal threshold between disclosure and visible differentiation.
Concrete or abstract arrival makes the evidence an event that enters the recipients' situation.

changed_reading.before: Clear evidence should simply end disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival is the threshold at which latent differences become visible and socially distinct, so clarification may precipitate division rather than cure it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recipients' prior passive receipt of the book is set against the later active arrival of evidence to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Granting establishes a settled inherited possession, whereas bringing or presenting establishes a fresh encounter. The decisive change occurs when possession is converted into confrontation with a presently delivered claim.

activation_trace.role: Granting supplies the recipients' already-held status and inherited possession.
Bringing or presenting something supplies the new encounter that tests prior possession.
Temporal succession orders settled receipt before the disruptive presentation.

changed_reading.before: Possessing the book and receiving the evidence are equivalent forms of access.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes inherited access from a new presentation: identity based on prior receipt is destabilized when its holders must answer a present arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier non-detachment is imaged as an interlocked or closed configuration, and the same evidence marks its limit. The focus scattering then reads as one possible state released when that configuration is opened.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal into parts supplies the released configuration visible in the focus.
Afterness places that released configuration beyond the evidentiary threshold.
Opening what is closed and separating what is interlocked supplies the phase-change mechanism.
Departure, or its grammatically negated absence, supplies the held state before the limit.
Clear disclosure supplies the shared boundary event at which the held state can change.

structural_cues: 98:1 holds non-detachment under an until-boundary ending with the evidence, while 98:4 places scattering beyond the matching after-boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interlocked opening or non-departure and the paired until/after sequence; I infer that the evidentiary arrival releases a held configuration into separation. A live alternative is that it ends one attachment without causing the later intra-group split.

changed_reading.before: The evidence merely precedes an independently arising disagreement.
changed_reading.after: The evidence functions as a phase boundary: what could not disengage before it becomes capable of opening and scattering afterward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrival is unfolded as an authorized messenger, sequential vocal following, written sheets, and removal of impurity. Evidence is thus a public transmission event with a person, temporal performance, material carrier, and quality control.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something lets the focus arrival receive a concrete delivery mechanism.
Disclosing meaning through speech, writing, or sign joins the performed and written channels.
Messenger and message supply the authorized human carrier of the presentation.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as an ordered unfolding rather than a static object.
A written sheet supplies the material carrier whose contents can be publicly followed.
Purity through removal of contamination supplies the carrier's asserted integrity.

structural_cues: 98:2 immediately expands the preceding evidence with a messenger, an act of recitation, and written material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the messenger-recitation-sheets-purity sequence; I infer that this sequence specifies the delivery event that the focus says came to the recipients. The live alternative is that the evidence denotes the whole complex rather than any one component.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is an abstract proposition that recipients privately assess.
changed_reading.after: It arrives as an authorized, audible, materially carried performance, so the later division is a response to enacted communication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contextual writings are characterized by straightness, support, and maintenance. This relocates instability away from the delivered material: content that is represented as standing and rectifying encounters holders who scatter.

activation_trace.role: Joining into a whole supplies the focus book's internal coherence.
Scattering into parts supplies the opposed behavior of the recipients.
Joined letters and written texts identify the evidence's contents as articulated writings.
Straightness and balanced uprightness supply the contents' normative alignment.
Support and sustaining structure make the writings a stabilizing framework rather than a fragmenting one.

structural_cues: 98:3 places the upright characterization inside the written sheets before 98:4 reports the recipients' scattering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coherent writing, uprightness, support, and the following audience split; I assign instability to reception rather than to defective content. A live alternative is that the upright description marks value without making any claim about audience causation.

changed_reading.before: The split could reflect ambiguity or instability in the delivered textual material.
changed_reading.after: The material is framed as coherent and rectifying; the instability belongs to how its holders respond to a stable norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disclosed meaning becomes an obligation architecture: binding request, devoted obedience, purification from admixture, exclusive orientation, directional turning, and established upright practice. The evidence reorganizes allegiance and conduct, giving the split practical and social stakes.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of intended meaning supplies the content-bearing capacity of the evidence.
Distinguishing and setting apart supplies the social result of divergent compliance.
Request carrying obligation supplies the normative force of the disclosed program.
Worship as submissive obedience supplies the program's governing relation.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies the demanded concentration of allegiance.
Obedience and submission supply the integrated order in which the commands operate.
Inclining toward a direction supplies deliberate reorientation rather than passive assent.
Establishing straightness and balance supplies the program's durable practical form.

structural_cues: The exclusive construction in 98:5 echoes the focus exclusion while replacing temporal sequence with the content of obligation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commands for exclusive devotion, directional turning, and established practice; I infer that such reorganizing demands explain why disclosure can divide its recipients. The live alternative is that 98:5 states the intended norm without describing the sociology of the split.

changed_reading.before: The division concerns assent to a proposition or interpretation alone.
changed_reading.after: The evidence demands reordered allegiance and repeated practice, so division marks divergent willingness to inhabit an entire normative pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same granting-root reverses participant direction: the focus group has been given a book, while the context requires them to give an act associated with growth. Possession is tested by whether received value is turned into outward circulation.

activation_trace.role: Granting supplies the passive receipt by which the group is named in the focus.
The written book supplies the value already placed in the recipients' custody.
The repeated granting image reverses the group from recipient to active giver.
Growth and increase make the outward gift a circulation that produces increase rather than mere loss.

structural_cues: The focus uses the granting-root in a passive identity formula, and 98:5 repeats it in an active commanded form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root recurrence with reversed giver-recipient roles and immediately names growth; I infer a reciprocity test in which received authority must become outward action. The live alternative is that the recurrence is ordinary wording without thematic reversal.

changed_reading.before: Having been given the book is a sufficient static credential.
changed_reading.after: Received authority creates an obligation to become a giver; the split exposes whether possession becomes generative practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast places concealment of truth on one side and trusted assent joined to intentional, repair-oriented action on the other, then evaluates the two within the same created field. The focus differentiation becomes response-based sorting rather than random factionalization.

activation_trace.role: Distinguishing and setting apart supplies the sorting operation in the focus.
Disclosure supplies the common criterion before responses diverge.
Covering the truth supplies one response to what has been disclosed.
Trusted assent that settles the heart supplies the opposed receptive response.
Intentional action carries assent into observable conduct.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the quality by which that conduct is evaluated.
Badness supplies the negative pole assigned to one response trajectory.
Excellence and selection supply the positive pole assigned to the other trajectory.
Creation supplies a common comparison field for the negative evaluation.
The repeated creation image holds the positive evaluation within that same field.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 repeat the same creation label while assigning opposed evaluations, and the positive side explicitly couples assent with action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed responses, actions, and evaluations after the focus split; I infer that evidence sorts by enacted response rather than by inherited label alone. A live alternative is that the later contrast classifies outcomes without explaining the mechanism of the earlier division.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an undifferentiated schism within a named community.
changed_reading.after: The schism resolves into a criterion-based distinction between covering disclosure and entrusting oneself to it through repair-oriented action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch images separation as a fork in a road; later recompense matches action, and repeated permanence fixes both outcome directions. Mutual acceptance on the positive side makes the divergence relational as well as spatial and temporal.

activation_trace.role: A road fork supplies the spatial model for one prior course dividing into trajectories.
Afterness gives the fork an irreversible sequence beyond the evidentiary encounter.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies consequence corresponding to trajectory.
Persistence resistant to decay fixes the negative trajectory rather than leaving it momentary.
The repeated persistence image fixes the positive trajectory with matching durability.
Long duration and continuance intensify the settled quality of the positive outcome.
Mutual acceptance supplies a reciprocal relation at the end of one trajectory.

structural_cues: The opposed populations in 98:6-7 are followed by recompense in 98:8, while persistence language occurs on both outcome sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a road-fork image, matching recompense, and durable endpoints; I infer that the focus split matures into path-dependent trajectories. The live alternative is that the fork is only an analogy and the outcomes do not grammatically state the split's causal continuation.

changed_reading.before: The post-evidence division is a temporary dispute at one historical moment.
changed_reading.after: It is a fork whose enacted directions acquire matching, durable outcomes and distinct final relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant mapped target for the recitation root and a causative branch of the focus arrival root, while the surface verbs need not bear those senses. It remains anchored to the focus arrival and cleaving predicate and to the context delivery event; downstream prose should render it only as a pressure or toppling analogy, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly couples an arrival with a cleaving or scattering result.

activation_trace.role: Driving or compelling supplies a possible pressure vector within the arrival inventory.
Cleaving into a separated mass supplies the visible fracture associated with that pressure.
The non-dominant split target's pouring and pushing image supplies a forceful mode for the delivery event.

changed_reading.before: Recited evidence is neutral information placed before a community.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its delivery acts like applied pressure that forces a latent fault line to cleave.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar presents a plural social division, whereas the cited branch concerns fear splitting the heart and the closing fear belongs to a positively evaluated figure. It remains anchored in the focus predicate and the context's fear-with-awe cue; downstream prose should preserve it as an affective echo beneath communal division, not identify the two constructions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus separation-root includes an affective branch in which fear internally scatters the heart.

activation_trace.role: A heart split by intense fear supplies an inward analogue to the outward scattering.
Disclosure supplies the encounter capable of producing an inward as well as social response.
Fear joined with awe supplies the explicit affective cue that reactivates the focus branch.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only an external communal schism.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the outward split may carry an inward heart-splitting response to overwhelming disclosure, with awe capable of yielding a different trajectory from panic.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses peripheral recovery branches for the focus separation-root and the later creation-root rather than the ordinary senses of the surface forms. It remains anchored to the focus split and is reinforced by contextual purification and repair images; downstream prose should frame it only as an ethical convalescence analogy in which some separation removes corruption, not as the verse's direct denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One focus branch images recovery as an illness departing from the patient, allowing separation to be restorative rather than merely destructive.

activation_trace.role: Recovery through illness departing supplies a restorative branch of separation.
Purity through removal of contamination supplies the cleansing analogue.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the positive function of what remains after removal.
Recovery from illness reactivates the same convalescent image at the positive evaluation.

changed_reading.before: Every post-evidence separation is simply communal decay.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, one branch of separation can be imagined as pathology leaving a body, so differentiation may expose a purified and repair-capable remainder.

strongest_changes: The context turns the evidence into a phase-transition trigger: what was held together before it can open and separate after it.
Messenger, sequential recitation, purified sheets, and upright writings make the arrival a performed and materially transmitted norm rather than abstract information.
The focus's receiver identity is tested by active giving and established practice, while later opposed evaluations sort one created field by enacted response.
The initial split can be tracked as a fork whose directions acquire matching and durable outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest latent pattern is inversion: joined writing versus scattered holders, prior non-detachment versus post-arrival release, passive receipt versus active giving, and stable content versus divergent response. Split mappings also opened pressure, inner-fear, and convalescence outliers without displacing the direct reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The evidence may denote the messenger, the recited contents, the whole delivery complex, or a wider manifest proof.
The temporal threshold strongly supports sequence, but treating the arrival as the efficient cause of division remains a reader-supplied arrow.
The non-dominant and peripheral branch outliers may remain audit-only if downstream prose cannot preserve their containment.
